verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships an OpenAI-compatible server (`edge0 serve edge0-35b`), so assigning a model alias is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never documents a way to set a custom identifier for a loaded model. Models are referenced only by tier name or path, with the tier auto-detected from config.json, which is an adjacent behavior rather than a user-assigned alias.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
